items.text: Cleveland: no notable new injuries. On IR: G Teven Jenkins, RB Raheim Sanders, LB Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah; DT Kalia Davis out for season.

New Orleans (TBD): RB CJ Donaldson (shoulder), S Justin Reid (concussion), G Cesar Ruiz (knee). OT Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle surgery) out indefinitely; WR Jordyn Tyson on IR; RB Travis Etienne Jr. eligible to return from IR.
